results.title: Salvable
results.overview: When a battered boxer past his prime finds his dreams and his relationships on the ropes, he falls back in with a dangerous crowd and has to take the biggest swing of his life to reclaim his hope and his family.

results.title: Le film de sa vie
results.overview: A depressive director returns to his childhood countryside to prepare a new film, accompanied by an alcoholic producer. But things don't go according to plan, and ghosts from the past resurface.

results.title: Death Whisperer 3
results.overview: Malevolent forces and a vengeful spirit target a schoolgirl, forcing her brother to venture into a twisted forest to save her from an accursed cult.

results.title: Putin
results.overview: A portrait of a formidable political figure, unraveling the contrasting facets of an iron-fisted tyrant and a man haunted by fear.

results.title: Frenzy Moon
results.overview: Six college grad students and a mysterious stranger battle a pack of ferocious werewolves in a secluded cabin.

results.title: French Lover
results.overview: When a jaded actor meets a down-on-her-luck waitress in Paris, their unexpected love story begins — but will it survive the glare of the spotlight?

results.title: Re/Member: The Last Night
results.original_title: カラダ探し THE LAST NIGHT
results.overview: Three years after completing a deadly game, high schoolers trapped in a looping nightmare must survive brutal encounters and unravel a terrifying curse.

results.title: 1st Kiss
results.overview: After losing her husband to death following a troubled marriage, a woman unexpectedly travels back to the moment before their first meeting, allowing them to reconnect and rekindle their romance.

results.title: A Firefighter's Christmas Calendar
results.overview: When firefighter Dani Reed rescues a family just before Christmas, she reignites her late mother's "Holiday Heroes" fundraiser to help the community. With her ambitious sister Jackie, charming photographer Sasha, and supportive dad by her side, Dani finds love, purpose, and the courage to step into true leadership.

results.title: Kannappa
results.overview: After witnessing the cruel sacrifice of his childhood friend, an atheist warrior rejects religion until love forces him to find his own faith.

results.title: ACHT
results.overview: A single long-range shot shatters the quiet of a country morning, leaving a beloved doctor dead on the steps of his family home. In the aftermath, a grieving widow and her withdrawn son cling desperately to the safety of routine. Meanwhile, a weary detective – mid-divorce and living out of a suitcase – is called to investigate, joined by a young colleague still reeling from a recent trauma.

results.title: Paul
results.overview: Struggling with depression and social anxiety, Paul has found refuge in serving women who invite him to clean their homes. By sharing his gently eccentric routines on social media, he combats loneliness and takes it one day at a time.

results.title: Sexa
results.overview: Bárbara, 60, fed up with society's expectations of aging women, swears off romance to please her son. But when she falls for 35-year-old Davi, she must choose between the role imposed on her or embracing a passionate new love.

results.title: BELA D.
results.overview: In the shadow of the Dutch childcare-benefits scandal, Danielle, a devoted mother, struggles to keep her household afloat amidst bureaucratic red tape and financial ruin. As tax authority letters pile up, a mysterious figure, Bela, enters their lives, tasked with restoring order.

results.title: Pandora: Fire and Ice
results.overview: Decades after humanity's first contact with Pandora, a new expedition returns to harvest what's left of the planet's resources-only to discover that the alien species is preparing to strike back against Earth.

results.title: Dyngus Day
results.overview: Stan fled his small town life in search of fame and fortune. Little did he know that he'd be forced to return in order to write the perfect story on the perfect holiday. Stan is met with a myriad of characters including his childhood crush , a deranged homeless man, and the egotistical mayor (these are 3 spearate people BTW) Oh, and did we mention there is a spirit of ancient evil bent on death and destruction?  We Didnt? Our Bad.  Can stan defeat this creature, get the girl and along the way learn the meaning of one of the weirdest holidays ever (that we swear is a real thing)? You'll have to watch the movie to find out! Join local springville heroes, September Brothers, as they present a tale of love, killing and plenty of Krupnik! What else could it be but DYNGUS DAY!

results.title: Everything's Going to Be Great
results.overview: When they are unexpectedly forced to move in with an estranged relative, the Smart Family must navigate oversized dreams, identity struggles and regional theater in this warmly observant family comedy.

results.title: 27 Club
results.overview: A 27-year-old filmmaker's perception of success and identity are challenged as he struggles to make a retirement video for his grandmother.

results.title: Qifarah
results.overview: An estranged son returns from abroad to care for his dying father, only to uncover dark, sinister secrets about his family that span both his past and present.

results.title: Twelfth Night
results.overview: Join us to revel in the midsummer madness as twins Sebastian and Viola survive shipwreck, revenge plots, and the trick doors of love. The Public’s Associate Artistic Director and Resident Director, Tony Award nominee Saheem Ali directs this joyful romp welcoming all of New York back to the magic of Central Park’s beloved theater.
